facts.fact: The Ministry of Education's National Policy Dialogue of 1-5 September 2025 validated a costed three-year action plan for EMIS modernisation whose priorities include a national unique Learner and Teacher ID system, with a financing framework of 60% government and 40% development partners, according to the African Union Commission.
facts.system: National unique Learner and Teacher ID system

facts.fact: The Ministry of Education led the engagement and signed the EMIS Validation Report with AU-IPED at its close; the Minister was nominated EMIS Data Champion.
facts.system: National unique Learner and Teacher ID system

facts.fact: A costed three-year EMIS action plan introducing national unique Learner and Teacher IDs was validated and the EMIS Validation Report signed at the close of the 1-5 September 2025 engagement; the Minister said a GPE-supported funding proposal for ICT and infrastructure upgrades had been initiated.
facts.system: National unique Learner and Teacher ID system

note: This release dates the last school census to 2021, where the peer review report says 2022. The 60/40 financing is an endorsed framework, not a budget line, so no finance fact is recorded.
